reason: I didn't even know it was there, but if it's in my own complex I'd try it a couple of times on my 11am break instead of walking out. My morning coffee stays at Qahwa BLK on the way in, though, because it's quick and cheaper.
objection: 2.80 for an Americano is more than I pay at the chain, and I don't know if they're fast enough for a ten-minute break.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper takeaway coffee for people who work in the complex, around 2 JOD, and a promise it's ready in a couple of minutes would make it my daily stop.
